name: usage-header
description: Compact band above the prompt: context window usage bar plus the 5-hour and weekly limits and where the session runs. Hungarian (default) or English.

language.title: Language / Nyelv
language.description: "hu" (default): magyar. "auto": Hungarian when the system locale (LANG) is Hungarian, English otherwise. "en": English.

machineNames.title: Machine names / Gépnevek
machineNames.description: Host name to display name for the location row, as host=Name pairs separated by commas. Unmapped hosts show their raw name.
